visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing a white V-neck top and a pearl necklace, speaks directly into a handheld camera in a well-lit, upscale indoor lobby. She has a lively expression and small gold earrings. (2) She raises her smartphone to the lens, displaying a promotional video of a celebrity (Kim Tae-hee) in various glamorous poses. Visual text overlays appear in bright colors. (3) The scene shifts to a large, dimly lit event ballroom with many round tables and guests. The woman walks through a glass door and then stands before a blue branded backdrop with 'JING CHI' logos, posing with finger hearts. (4) Detailed close-up of the woman's hands holding a faceted, diamond-shaped blue gift box and a blue 'JING CHI' voucher card. (5) She interacts playfully with two tall male models wearing crisp white shirts and black trousers. They present her with a blue shopping bag. (6) Fast-paced shots show a plated meal with meat and vegetables, followed by a wide shot of female musicians playing violins and a cello on a stage illuminated by blue and purple lights. (7) The celebrity Kim Tae-hee is seen on the main stage wearing a white off-the-shoulder gown, holding a microphone and smiling at a large crowd of people holding up phones. (8) The woman holds up a printed photo strip featuring herself and friends with the celebrity's image in the frame. She speaks to the camera in a corridor with people walking behind her. (9) Final shot of her addressing the audience directly in the event hall before the screen fades.

(2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the scene shifts. The speaker's pitch rises with excitement when mentioning the celebrity name. (3) Ambient chatter of an event crowd is heard faintly in the background. (4) A digital UI 'ping' sound occurs as she interacts with her phone. (5) Acoustic violin and cello melodies emerge, blending with the electronic beat, creating a hybrid classical-modern texture during the stage shots. (6) A burst of applause and collective cheering (crowd noise) peaks as a new speaker appears on stage. (7) Final playful 'pop' sound effect as she signs off with a cheerful laugh.
